main_text.p: Si quæras igitur, quænam sit vera Ecclesia, breuissima est responsio, & verissima: Ecclesia vera est, quæ regulam fidei vnam, eandem, indemutabilem confessuar. Quum igitur docuerimus, hanc regulam fidei per omnes Ecclesiæ successiones fuisse agnitam, susceptam, celebratam, perpetuoque conseruatam vsque ad Concilii Tridentini tempora: Quumque constet, fuisse eandem regulam susceptam ab Ecclesiis reformatis, per quam regulam nostræ Ecclesiæ suam communionem probant cum Ecclesiis antiquis, cum Ecclesia denique Catholica: fuisse etiam hanc regulam à Pontificiis mutatam in pseudosynodo Tridentina: Quum hæc, inquam, constituerint, expedita via, ratioq; constabit inueniendi Ecclesiam, quam quærimus.

Regula fidei vel summaria est, vel completa, & perfectè explicata. Summaria regula est in Symbolo Apostolico. Itaque nonnulli Patres, quum regulam fidei proponunt, Symbolum explicant. Completa regula est doctrina Propherica & Apostolica in sacris Scripturis comprehensa; ac proinde multi Patres in regula fidei designanda, vniuersas Scripturas proponunt. Idemque habetur apud Patres, Ecclesiam probari per regulam fidei, & Ecclesiam probari per Scripturas. De qua re deinceps dicetur.
Miseri homines, & Scripturarum lucifugæ, ab Ecclesiæ Catholicæ societate per vitæ impuritatem deiecti, ipsam Scripturarum lucem

page.notes:
Left page: the text is partly blurred by a grey stain across the middle and lower part, but the words are legible except where marked. "confessuar" [?] is doubtful, and "Propherica" is copied as printed. The catchword "exosam" is the first word of the next page. The paragraph beginning "Miseri homines" continues on the next page, so no closing mark is given. The handwritten mark at top left is excluded.
Right page: only the left edge of the text survives, cut off by the scan edge, so the lines are fragments and are given as <l> lines in reading order. They are not paragraphs; the paragraph breaks cannot be determined from what is visible.
